newsitem.title: CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: French kill suspected thief in Bangui shootout.
newsitem.headline: French kill suspected thief in Bangui shootout.

text.p: French troops in Central African Republic killed a man and wounded another in a shootout with gunmen in a stolen car, the French army said on Thursday.
It said the clash took place on Wednesday night when four men in the stolen car opened fire on French troops as they approached the vehicle at a roadblock in the capital Bangui.
"As the soldiers approached to identify the occupants of the vehicle, the latter opened fire on the French, who immediately riposted in legitimate self-defence," an army statement said.
One gunman was killed on the spot and another wounded lightly. A third escaped while the fourth was arrested. There was no mention of any casualty on the French side.

French troops stationed in Central African Republic under defence accords with Paris helped quell bloody mutinies last year by local soldiers. African peacekeepers have started to take over patrol duty from the French following accords ending the latest revolt which erupted in November.
